title: vitaldb-resolution: VitalDB recorded values and times as distributions of the true value
description: Every recorded VitalDB time and value as a probability distribution of the true value: native resolution, or a mixture of rounding modes deconvolved from heaped data. Models are versioned JSON files evaluated by one generic engine.

creators.name: Goodwin, Andrew J.
creators.affiliation: School of Biomedical Engineering, The University of Sydney
